assumptions: Only mode eligibility changes: SURVIVAL/ADVENTURE already permitted; CREATIVE/SPECTATOR no longer rejected solely by mode. No mode grants, permission changes or synthetic completion. Mode-specific previously-denied cohort is measured as before0; the same UUID could previously switch to Survival, so this is not a forecast of wholly new players.

Stuck recovery and more valid pens may improve actual throughput; no measured hourly claim.

Creative flight and Spectator movement can shorten travel. No additional MONEY boost, speed/farmperk multiplier, price, tax, XP, crystal, item grant or premium-token change. Borrowed props remain temporary non-saleable workpieces, inventory transfer rules remain authoritative.

No new paid entitlement/full equipment purchase or progression price changes; savings time cannot be derived from unmeasured disposable income. Neighbouring sidejobs share existing quota; their payout amount is unchanged.

Duplicate/invalid clicks, repeated recovery and retry remain zero additional payment via existing state/receiptidempotence. Upper daily mint stays2000Vault/UUID;10UUIDs20000/day; no networkweeklybudget or new multiaccount rule.

NPC identities/leases, support floors, assigned reachable objectives and owned cart identity remain validated regardless mode. Existing missed work can now complete but no actual emission delta is inferred from improved reliability.
